verdict.rationale:
Vercel Sandbox is explicitly designed to run untrusted/agent-generated code in isolated Linux microVMs 'without exposing your production systems,' with per-agent isolation, ephemeral or persistent state, and no shared access to production infrastructure. This directly matches the AI-native story of testing agent code safely away from production data.

missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of real-world isolation guarantees, and explicit documentation on data-boundary controls preventing production data leakage into sandboxes.
